newsitem.title: UK: DIARY - Today in Westminster - Nov 12.
newsitem.headline: DIARY - Today in Westminster - Nov 12.

text.p: The UK government has called a news conference on Tuesday to give its reaction to the European Court ruling on whether Britain must implement a 48-hour maximum working week agreed in Brussels.
Trade and Industry Secretary Ian Lang will address journalists at 1135 GMT.
Other events scheduled in and around parliament are as follows --
- Eight Conservative MPs who temporarily lost the whip for their Euroscepticism give press conference on the 48-hour work week ruling, 1100 GMT.
- Questions to the Social Security Secretary at 1430 GMT.
- Questions to the Prime Minister at 1515 GMT.
- Firearms (Amendment) Bill, second reading from about 1530 GMT.
- Foreign Affairs Committee holds inquiry into BBC World Service. Witnesses include FCO minister Jeremy Hanley. 1030 GMT.
- Royal British Legion briefing on Gulf War illnesses. Committee Room W1. 1230 GMT.
